verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic marketing language about visual building, code extensibility, and error-workflow handling, but no documentation of IF/Switch/Filter nodes or a Merge node that would let branches recombine. Community and docs items never describe conditional branching or parallel-path merging explicitly, so the specific branch-and-merge capability is unevidenced. Missing for 10: docs/evidence on conditional (IF/Switch) nodes, filter nodes, and a Merge node for recombining parallel paths.
